observed_behavior: Authenticated reuse produced ACTIVE/OPEN, which reconciliation rejected and could not integrate after worker activation.
expected_behavior: The original authenticated worker can activate its plan and deliver that transition through the ordinary serialized join.
causal_mechanism: Dispatch completion and lifecycle reconciliation described different legitimate intermediate states; merge readiness repeated the latter assumption.

anti_pattern.structural_description: A producer emits a state rejected by its consumer until a downstream operation finishes.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: The downstream activation/integration operation is blocked by that very intermediate-state diagnostic.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Proven intermediate states remain valid through the operation that completes their transition, without permitting unproven states.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Matching dispatch and binding proof permits initial lifecycle reconciliation/integration; delivery still requires worker activation and exact clean evidence.

applicability_conditions: Dispatch authenticates before worker-owned lifecycle changes are permitted.
Lifecycle changes reach the coordinator only through integration.
known_non_matches: Rejected and deferred plans do not become valid through dispatch proof.
confirmation_evidence: Live original audit assignment, successful dispatch, matching binding, and both OPEN plan locators were independently inspected.
The real Git/authenticated binding regression failed before the fix on CAMPAIGN_ASSIGNMENT_LIFECYCLE.
regression_proofs: tests/campaign-orchestration.test.js: authenticated dispatch stays valid while its worker activates an open plan and integrates activation
